categories.label: Dimensional / Geometric
categories.desc: Dimension discrepancies between sheets, conflicting datums, wall assembly totals that don't match their component layers, and missing code-critical dimensions.

categories.label: Building Envelope
categories.desc: Vapor control, air barrier continuity, insulation placement and values, flashing details, and whether wall and roof assemblies perform appropriately for the project climate.

categories.label: Code and Life Safety
categories.desc: Egress paths, minimum door and railing dimensions, fire separation requirements, makeup air for exhaust systems, and other conditions requiring code compliance.

categories.label: Constructability
categories.desc: Whether details can physically be built as drawn — door swing clearances, missing flashing, system conflicts, and architectural elements that require coordination not shown.

categories.label: Schedule-to-Drawing
categories.desc: Door and window schedule entries that conflict with what is drawn on plans or elevations — wrong widths, wrong materials, wrong finishes for the assigned room.

categories.label: Spec-to-Drawing Conflicts
categories.desc: Conflicts between the project specifications and the drawn documents — different products, different quantities, different performance requirements, different assembly configurations.

categories.label: Completeness and Clarity
categories.desc: Missing tags, orphaned keynotes, TBD items that prevent accurate bidding, dead cross-references, deferred design decisions, and annotations that are ambiguous or absent.

incorrect.claim: [B-2]: 10 equal risers and 8 equal risers at 6 11/16" does not cleanly reconcile to the 10'-0" Level 1 to Level 2 floor-to-floor height
incorrect.why: Stair has 18 total risers across two runs (10 east + 8 south); 18 × 6-11/16" ≈ 10'-0". The model correctly identified both runs but asserted an irreconcilable discrepancy where only normal rounding exists.

incorrect.claim: [D-1]: Roof areas drawn at very low slope are covered by the same standing-seam metal roof assembly as the main roofs, but no separate low-slope roofing assembly is provided
incorrect.why: Detail 5/A4.13 specifically shows and addresses the low-slope roof condition. The claim that it is undetailed is a misread of the drawing set.

incorrect.claim: [B-1]: East stair section shows 10 EQ RISERS at 6-11/16" — model concludes a single flight cannot reach Level 2 (5'-7" total rise vs 10'-0" floor-to-floor)
incorrect.why: Stair has 18 total risers across two runs (10 east + 8 south), yielding ~6-11/16" per riser — code-compliant. The model treated the east flight alone as the full stair.

incorrect.claim: [A-7]: Window Type 10 (7'-6" × 1'-6", count 1) is scheduled but not locatable or identifiable on any elevation or plan provided
incorrect.why: Window Type 10 is visible on elevation 1/A3.02. The model's claim that it cannot be found is a misread.

incorrect.claim: [E-4]: No sill height dimensions or window fall-protection notes provided for upper-level windows (IRC R312.2)
incorrect.why: Level 2 window sill heights are dimensioned on 2/A3.03 and 1/A3.01. The claim that they are absent is a misread.

incorrect.claim: B-1: south section 8 risers over 10'-0" floor-to-floor = 15" riser (geometrically impossible); B-2: east section 10 risers at 6-11/16" = ~5'-7" total rise, irreconcilable with 10'-0" floor-to-floor
incorrect.why: Stair has 18 total risers split across two runs (10 east + 8 south); neither run alone spans the full floor-to-floor height. Both sections are correct for their respective partial runs.

incorrect.claim: Base exterior detail (A4.11/5) lacks a capillary break or through-wall flashing at wood sill plate, allowing moisture wicking from CMU to wood framing
incorrect.why: The detail shows metal flashing that provides a drainage gap and air vent; the capillary break condition is present. Flagging it as absent is a misread of the detail.

incorrect.claim: Window Tag 3 count listed as 6 in schedule; plans appear to show only 5 locations
incorrect.why: The correct count of Tag 3 windows is reflected in the schedule. The model is miscounting.

incorrect.claim: Stair section 1/A3.22 shows 10 equal risers for the upper run, but floor-to-floor height of 10'-0" requires 18 total risers
incorrect.why: The stair has two runs: 10 risers (east) + 8 risers (south) = 18 total, yielding compliant ~6-11/16" each. The model treated one run as the full stair.

incorrect.claim: Stair opening and run dimensions on level 1 do not have matching tread/riser counts or total run on level 2 plan
incorrect.why: The stair has 18 total risers across two separate runs (10 going east on Level 1, 8 going south on Level 2). The model misreads the two distinct legs as a Level 1-vs-Level 2 discrepancy rather than recognizing them as different runs of a single two-run stair.

incorrect.claim: Window schedule lists Ultrex/Marvin frames (fiberglass) while exterior details call out 2x6 Accoya wood frames (WD-2) — direct material conflict (rated Certain)
incorrect.why: The Accoya frame is the exterior casing/buck around the window unit, not the window frame itself. The detail was coordinated; no conflict exists.

incorrect.claim: Stair callouts show '10 EQ RISERS 11"' for a 10'-0" floor-to-floor height — geometry doesn't add up (rated High)
incorrect.why: The stair has two runs: 10 risers (east) + 8 risers (south) = 18 total, yielding compliant ~6-11/16" each. The model misread one run as the full stair.

incorrect.claim: Detail lacks a clear continuous thermal break at the sill/foundation-wall interface (rated High)
incorrect.why: Detail 6/A4.10 clearly shows a 3" thermal break at the foundation-to-wall interface. The claim that it is undetailed is incorrect.

incorrect.claim: South Elevation A3.02 displays a window tagged with a hex '1' under the porch, but the Window Schedule on A8.01 starts at Tag 2 and contains no Tag 1
incorrect.why: No window Tag 1 exists in the current set. The apparent tag is a misread — likely linework overlapping the tag or a door tag being read as a window tag.

incorrect.claim: Enlarged Plan A2.01A depicts door 08-1 (Master Closet) as a pocket door, but the Door Schedule lists it without pocket hardware or designation
incorrect.why: Door 08-1 is not labeled or shown as a pocket door. The plan swing arc and schedule entry are consistent.

incorrect.claim: The First Floor Reflected Ceiling Plan depicts Garage 15 as entirely blank, contradicting the specs which mandate 4 interior lights in the garage
incorrect.why: Four garage lights are correctly shown on the reflected ceiling plan. The model is misreading the RCP.

incorrect.claim: Overall longitudinal dimension string North side totals 72'-1" but South side adds up to 72'-1½" — a ½" discrepancy
incorrect.why: The dimension strings are correct. All plan dimension strings are assumed accurate unless specifically identified as a benchmark error.

incorrect.claim: 10 EQ RISERS between Level 1 and Level 2 results in 12" riser height — exceeds IRC maximum of 7-3/4"
incorrect.why: Stair has 18 total risers across two runs (10 east + 8 south), yielding ~6-11/16" per riser — code-compliant. Model misread a single run as the full stair.

incorrect.claim: Stair riser heights do not sum to the total floor-to-floor height (Certain)
incorrect.why: Stair has 18 risers across two runs (10 east + 8 south) at ~6-11/16" each — compliant with IRC max of 7-3/4". Model is claiming non-compliant geometry that does not exist.
